collection.description: A distracted healer realizes a patient received the wrong preparation.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A distracted healer confuses two preparations and notices only after a patient receives one.

choices.label: Admit the error immediately and seek help.
Investigate what was given and monitor the patient.
Conceal the mistake, worsening trust if discovered.

outcome.name: Ending
outcome.text: The decision may restore confidence, create a new apprenticeship, change profession or duties, or expose a preventable error. An honest admission can still bring accountability; concealment may appear to work initially but create a delayed callback.
